title: Nonnegativity of the expectation of a product of squares
statement:
For any two Boolean functions $g, h : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$, the expectation of the product of their squares under the uniform measure is nonnegative:
\[
  \E\!\left[\,g^2\, h^2\,\right] \;=\; 2^{-n} \sum_{x \in \{0,1\}^n} g(x)^2\, h(x)^2 \;\ge\; 0.
\]
hypotheses_covered: g and h are Boolean functions of arity n
